newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds climbs amid talk of switching.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds climbs amid talk of switching.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds TSB Group climbed to their highest level since last December amid talk of switching out of some other banks into Lloyds, traders said.
By 1150 GMT, Lloyds shares were up 7p to 414-1/2 on volume of 2.3 million. The shares have risen by about 11.5 percent during the last three weeks.
One analyst attributed the recent rise to a shortage of stock in the market. "Standard Life disclosed buying three million (Lloyds) shares and I think that left the market short of stock," he said.
